comment: The recurrence of components across goals is used to justify their classification as DPI-H. Recurrence demonstrates reuse potential but does not, by itself, establish public-good characteristics, governance feasibility, cost-effectiveness, or appropriateness as shared national infrastructure.

public.text: The recurrence of components across goals is used to justify their classification as DPI-H. Recurrence demonstrates reuse potential but does not, by itself, establish public-good characteristics, governance feasibility, cost-effectiveness, or appropriateness as shared national infrastructure.
public.suggestedRevision: Treat recurrence as one criterion among several. Add public-interest value, standards-based accessibility, lifecycle stability, governance viability, cost-effectiveness, and avoidance of unjustified centralisation.
